captions_note: the reel's captions keep running over the wipe
in_a_reel: one slot per cut, across the cut, about 0.5 s each side. Choose WIPE by name; a second cut takes a second slot (--name)
a wipe holds one frame of each shot for a few frames, so put it on a cut in a gap between words where you can
steps: edit WIPE in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # bakes assets/plate.mp4, prints the frames and the snapshot list
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
